endangerment.comment: Uruguayan Sign Language (7119-ugy) = Threatened (20 percent certain, based on the evidence available) (Ethnologue (2013) lists he vitality of Uruguayan Sign Language as: 5 (Developing).) [Simons; and Fennig 2013](cldf:simons;:fennig:ed:13)

classification.sub: Uruguayan Sign Language appears to be lexicostatistically distinct from Paraguayan Sign language (**hh:soc:ParksParks:Sordos-Paraguay**):8-9 and presumably from other sign languages as well.
